description: Test file for the ServiceCIDRs controller in Kubernetes, including unit tests for synchronization, deletion logic, and CIDR containment functions.

classes.name: testController
classes.description: Wrapper struct for the controller with additional stores for testing.

methods.name: newController
methods.description: Initializes a new test controller with given CIDRs and IP addresses, setting up informers and stores.

methods.name: TestControllerSync
methods.description: Unit test for the controller's sync logic, including handling of deletion, finalizers, and status updates.

methods.name: makeServiceCIDR
methods.description: Helper to create a ServiceCIDR object with specified name and CIDRs.

methods.name: makeIPAddress
methods.description: Helper to create an IPAddress object with specified name and family.

methods.name: expectAction
methods.description: Asserts that the actions performed match expected verbs, resources, and subresources.
